subject: Invitation to our Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear valued donors, We are thrilled to invite you to our Annual Charity Gala on November 15th at the Grand Ballroom. Join us for an evening of fundraising, entertainment, and delicious cuisine. Your continued support has made a significant impact on the lives of many in need. We look forward to celebrating with you and raising funds for our upcoming projects. Please RSVP by November 5th. Thank you for your generosity and commitment to our cause.
